import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebraModules
import MilneLib.Sheaf.FiniteProjectiveDescent

/-!
# Finite projectivity of Galois-invariant modules

The canonical comparison for a module over a semilinear Galois algebra,
together with faithful flatness over the fixed algebra, descends finite
presentation and finite projectivity. In particular the fixed module is free
on a basic open neighborhood of every prime. This is the affine algebraic
local-freeness step in Milne III.1.13; sheaf gluing is a separate assertion.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L R : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R] [IsScalarTower K L R]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R] [IsSemilinear K L R]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
variable (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module L M]
  [Module R M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]

/-- A finitely presented semilinear module has finitely presented invariants
over the fixed algebra. -/
theorem finitePresentation_invariantModule [Module.FinitePresentation R M] :
    Module.FinitePresentation (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      (invariantModule K L R M) := by
  let S := FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat S R := faithfullyFlat_fixedPoints K L R
  let e := moduleDescentEquiv K L R M
  have : Module.FinitePresentation R (R ⊗[S] invariantModule K L R M) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_surjective e.symm.toLinearMap e.symm.surjective
      (by simpa using Submodule.fg_bot)
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat
    S R (invariantModule K L R M)

/-- A finite projective semilinear module has projective invariants over the
fixed algebra. Finiteness is provided by `finite_invariantModule`. -/
theorem projective_invariantModule [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M] :
    Module.Projective (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      (invariantModule K L R M) := by
  let S := FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat S R := faithfullyFlat_fixedPoints K L R
  let e := moduleDescentEquiv K L R M
  have : Module.Finite R (R ⊗[S] invariantModule K L R M) := Module.Finite.equiv e.symm
  have : Module.Projective R (R ⊗[S] invariantModule K L R M) :=
    Module.Projective.of_equiv e.symm
  exact Module.Projective.of_projective_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat
    S R (invariantModule K L R M)

/-- A finite projective semilinear module descends to a module free on a
basic open neighborhood of each prime of the fixed algebra. -/
theorem exists_free_away_invariantModule [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))) :
    ∃ f : FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L), f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      Module.Free (Localization.Away f)
        (Localization.Away f ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
          invariantModule K L R M) := by
  let S := FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat S R := faithfullyFlat_fixedPoints K L R
  let e := moduleDescentEquiv K L R M
  have : Module.Finite R (R ⊗[S] invariantModule K L R M) := Module.Finite.equiv e.symm
  have : Module.Projective R (R ⊗[S] invariantModule K L R M) :=
    Module.Projective.of_equiv e.symm
  exact Module.exists_free_away_of_projective_tensorProduct S R
    (invariantModule K L R M) p

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
